limitations.no_rl_result: CF1 did not evaluate RL; the simulator is a separate retrospective study.
limitations.nonpositive_mixed: Source nonpositive includes inactive and inconclusive.
limitations.one_component: Six campaigns share one annotation-connected component.
limitations.seed_range_not_ci: Five-seed ranges are conditional repetitions, not biological confidence intervals.
